messages:
asha_pm: Hey all — CipherSync confirmed a marketplace listing slot for May 2. We need a quick sync on the security/identity integration runway before we lock the joint announcement. High level: SSO (SAML), SCIM for provisioning, KMS BYOK + optional HSM signing, and a secrets-sync path to Vault/KeyStore. Any immediate blockers?

mike_eng: Quick readout from infra: we've tested SAML metadata import and SCIM user creation flows against their staging IdP. SCIM patching for group mappings needs one small fix (mapping role -> redwood_role). Also need to validate PKCS#11 shim for the HSM vendor (CipherHSM) — their dev kit behaves slightly different in slot numbering.

kira_security: From a compliance POV we need the HSM to prove FIPS 140-2/3 level and support key export restrictions. For KMS BYOK: need key wrapping + EKM audit logs. Also ask CipherSync for an ATO artifact snapshot (certs, attestation) by Apr 10 so legal can review.

asha_pm: Got it. Action items: (1) @mike_eng fix SCIM role mapping PR by Apr 5, (2) @mike_eng + @raj_sre validate PKCS#11 slot mapping on CI by Apr 8, (3) @kira_security request FIPS attestation and EKM logs from CipherSync by Apr 10. If all green, marketing sends embargoed announcement copy on Apr 20.

raj_sre: Adding scheduling notes — we should do a canary roll for the secrets-sync job and a staged enable of BYOK. Proposed rollout windows: canary May 1 02:00-06:00 UTC, wide enable May 2 09:00 UTC. I'll put checks in the runbook: latency, error-rate spike detection, immediate fallback to managed-kms.

mike_eng: SCIM PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/scim/merge_requests/432 — includes role mapping and idempotent group patch. PKCS#11 shim tests: failing on slot 0 vs slot 1 assumptions; workaround in agent: export PKCS11_SLOT env var. Tests running in CI now.

deploy-bot: scheduled: marketplace-landing-page-deploy -> 2026-05-02T09:00:00Z (canary: 2026-05-01T02:00:00Z). See /deploy status for logs.

asha_pm: Great progress. Two ask items before I confirm the joint PR and press copy: (A) @ciphersync-account-team - can you confirm whether the HSM requires PKCS#11 slot remapping or if you can publish updated dev-kit with slot 0? (B) Marketing needs a short blurb about BYOK UX for customers (1-2 lines). If we have both by Apr 12 I can lock the announcement schedule.

kira_security: Also adding: we need an agreed incident response doc for key compromise scenarios that references CipherSync escalation contacts. I'll draft and share by Apr 9.

mike_eng: Noted — pinging CipherSync via email now with the slot question. Will update thread when they reply.

asha_pm: Thanks team — I'll update the joint timeline and send the embargoed copy to legal/marketing once we hit the Apr 12 checkpoint. :thumbsup:
